title: Landing pages
help: One public page per product, very light (it opens fast even on 3G). Orders arrive in Pilotix; fake ones are blocked without the customer knowing.

about.pages: An order page per product: its colour, pictures and text. Share its address in your ads.
about.bloquees: Orders the fake-order check held back. The customer saw the normal thank-you screen; restore the real ones.
about.abandons: Customers who left their number without ordering: Pilotix adds them to Commandes › New by itself so your agents call them.
about.reglages: Meta pixel and Conversions API, abandoned orders, automations.
about.protection: What the fake-order protection did: orders passed, to check, blocked, and the attacks (one device sending many numbers, numbers in a row).

list.empty: No page yet. Create the first one for a product.

view.demo: Demo: the order goes through the fake-order check, as on the real site.

ed.slugHint: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes. This is the link for your ads.
ed.active: Online (customers can open it and order)
ed.title: Title shown
ed.titleHint: Empty: the product name. You can write it in Arabic.
ed.oldPriceHint: Shows the discount in %. Empty: nothing.
ed.descriptionHint: A line starting with "- " becomes a bullet, "# " a heading, **bold** bold. Leave an empty line between paragraphs.
ed.fraudHelp: Each order gets a score from 0 to 100 (phone, name, speed, bot, the number’s history, repeats…). Above the threshold it is blocked silently; a bit below it arrives as "To check".

lvlHelp.relaxed: Blocks at 85, to check at 55. Fewest real orders blocked.
lvlHelp.normal: Blocks at 70, to check at 40. Recommended.
lvlHelp.strict: Blocks at 55, to check at 30. For a product hit hard by fake orders.

ed.removeAsk: Delete this page? Its address will stop working.
ed.fixedPrice: This product has a fixed price: the order will be at the catalogue price ({{price}}), not the page price.
ed.stockHideHelp: A sold-out variant shows "نفذت الكمية" and cannot be ordered; all sold out: the page says so instead of taking orders.
ed.stockAllOut: Careful: everything is sold out, the page will take no order until stock is back.

bl.note: The customer saw the same "Thank you, your order is received" screen as everyone: they do not know it was blocked. "Restore" turns it into a real order (New).
bl.restoreHelp: A real customer: create the order
bl.dismissHelp: Fake order: take it off the list

reasons.ip_many: Many orders from the same IP
reasons.wilaya_wave: Wave of orders in this wilaya
reasons.not_from_ad: Did not come from the ad

miss.title_one: {{count}} product has no landing page yet
miss.title_other: {{count}} products have no landing page yet
miss.help: A new product shows here as soon as it is created. "Create in 1 click" makes its page from its name, photo, variants and price; you complete it afterwards.
miss.ignoreHelp: This product will not get a page (an accessory…): no more alert for it
miss.ignored: No more alert for this product
miss.created: Page created: complete it and publish it

ab.note: A customer who types their number without ordering becomes a "New" order {{min}} minutes later, with no message sent to the customer. If they come back to order, there is no duplicate.
ab.empty_abandoned: Nothing to handle: abandoned orders are already in Commandes.
ab.noteOrder: Order abandoned on the landing page, completed after a call.
ab.completeHelp: Call the customer, pick their wilaya and commune: the order goes to Commandes › New, with no message to the customer.
ab.dismissHelp: Not interested or wrong number: remove from the list

set.footer: Pages load the Meta pixel only after they are shown (to stay fast on 3G), and never inside Pilotix (preview, demo).
set.metaHelp: The browser sends PageView, ViewContent and InitiateCheckout. The server sends Purchase through the Conversions API, only for a real order: a blocked order or one marked fake is never a sale for Meta.
set.pixelHint: Events Manager › Data sources. A page may have its own pixel.
set.testCodeHint: Events Manager › Test events. Clear it after testing.
set.tokenHint: Events Manager › your pixel › Settings › Generate a token. It never leaves the server.
set.tokenAdmin: Only the administrator can change it.
set.purchaseAt: When an order counts as a "Purchase" for Meta

paHelp.order: At once, when the fake-order check is sure. Fastest for Meta, but also counts customers who cancel later.
paHelp.confirmed: When an agent confirms by phone: Meta learns from real buyers.
paHelp.delivered: When the parcel is delivered and paid: the most accurate, but Meta learns it days later.

set.never: Never a Purchase for a blocked order, nor for one marked fake, duplicate, wrong number or cancelled before sending.
set.urlParamsHelp: Paste them in the ad (Meta › Ad › URL parameters): each order keeps its campaign, ad set and ad.
set.abandonedHelp: As soon as a customer types a valid number, Pilotix keeps it. If they do not order, their order goes to Commandes › New by itself, with no message to the customer: your agents call them.
set.afterHint: with no activity on the form (5 minutes at least)
set.autoCreate: Create a landing page for each new product
set.autoCreateHelp: Made when the product is created (name, photo, price, variants), to complete afterwards. Otherwise the product shows in "Pages" with an alert.
set.removeTokenAsk: Remove the Conversions API token? The Meta Ads token will be used instead, if there is one.
set.ignoredNone: None: every product on sale raises the alert until it has a page.
set.restored: The alert is back for this product
set.linkHelp: Every page has its own address: your site / the store's name / the page's name (the page's name is changed in the page). The old …/api/lp/… links keep working.
set.storeSlugHint: Latin letters, digits and dashes. Empty = « {{name}} » (made from the shop's name). After a change, links with the old name still lead to the right page.
set.storeFixed: Chosen by Pilotix when your shop was created: your order links use it too. To change it, write to Pilotix support.
set.tsHelp: An invisible check by Cloudflare (Turnstile), free: the customer sees nothing. A “robot” according to Cloudflare adds 40 points (never blocked by that alone). Create a widget at dash.cloudflare.com › Turnstile with your pages’ domain.
set.tsSiteHint: Public: it goes on the pages.

ev.title: Events sent to Meta
ev.help: What the server sent (or not, and why). A fake order shows as "skipped", never "sent".
ev.empty: Nothing sent yet (add the pixel ID).

alertHelp: On this device: a notification and a short sound when an order arrives from a landing page.

pHelp.max: Most faithful: no visible difference even zoomed in. Slightly heavier files.
pHelp.balanced: Recommended: no visible difference, files 2 to 4 times lighter than before. Ideal on 3G.
pHelp.light: Fastest (2G, weak 3G): a very slight loss when zooming, invisible on a phone.

ph.hint: Each photo is compressed in your browser: Pilotix finds the lowest quality that still looks the same as the original (measured), in 4 sizes (160, 480, 720, 960 px) + a blurred preview of a few bytes shown at once. A 4 MB photo reaches the customer as 30 to 80 KB. The first one is the main photo.
ph.gainHelp: Weight saved and quality: see before / after
ph.heavy_one: {{count}} photo comes from an address and is not compressed: it slows the page down.
ph.heavy_other: {{count}} photos come from an address and are not compressed: they slow the page down.
ph.fetchFail: This site does not let us read the photo. Save it on your phone, then add it with « Add photos ».
ph.urlKept: Photo added as is (the site does not let us compress it): it may be heavy.
ph.cmpLater: The side-by-side comparison is available right after adding the photo. Here is what the compression did:
ph.cmpSum: Original: {{orig}} ({{ow}} × {{oh}} px). On a phone the customer downloads {{phone}}, {{q}} % identical to the original.
ph.ssimHelp: « Identical »: measured similarity (MS-SSIM, at several scales like the eye) between the compressed photo and the original at the same size. Above 99 %, the eye sees no difference.

domain.title: Your own domain
domain.help: Your landing pages at your own address too: https://www.my-shop.com/<page>. Buy the domain from a registrar (OVH, Namecheap…), write it here, then point it to Pilotix. HTTPS comes by itself.
domain.label: Domain
domain.saved: Domain saved: point it to Pilotix
domain.notYet: The domain does not point to Pilotix yet (DNS can take a few hours)
domain.removeAsk: Remove this domain? Your pages stay on the Pilotix address.
domain.wait: Not yet: point the domain to Pilotix.
domain.how: At your registrar, in the domain’s DNS zone:
domain.name: Name
domain.howHelp: Delete the other A or AAAA records of this name. The change takes from a few minutes to a few hours.

pr.intro: Every order received gets a score: 🟢 it passes, 🟡 an agent checks before calling, 🔴 it is blocked without the customer knowing (they see the same “Thank you”).
pr.kMergedSub: sent again by the same customer
pr.byHourHelp: Attacks often come at night, when nobody is watching.
pr.noBlocked: No blocked order in this period.
pr.attacksHelp: One device sending 3 numbers or more, or numbers in a row (same first 8 digits). “Block this device” blocks all its next orders.
pr.blockAsk: Block this device? All its next orders will go to “Blocked orders” (the customer will not know).
pr.whyHelp: The most frequent reasons, over {{count}} blocked or to-check orders.
pr.marksHelp: When an agent sets “Fake” or “🕵️ Competitor”, the device that ordered is marked: 🟡 next time, 🔴 at the 2nd fake within 30 days or right away for “competitor”. The phone number is not punished (it may belong to someone who never ordered).
